slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
brilliantly well informed

reading long reads

read one long article a week from start to finish, slowly and carefully. deep reading slowly builds the patience and understanding that headlines never will.

watching lectures

watch one free university lecture a week on something completely new. an hour with a real expert teaches you more than a whole month of short videos ever could.

keeping a commonplace book

copy your favourite quotes and ideas into one notebook. reading it back years later shows you exactly how your thinking has grown and changed over time.

one lesson a day

spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in a subject you've never studied: economics, geology, art history. small daily doses build a genuinely brilliant mind.

debating with friends

pick one big question over dinner and debate it kindly with friends. defending your view out loud sharpens your thinking faster than reading ever could alone.
